headers.comment: Every SPA route is served the same index.html, and a request for a route arrives as '/' or '/staff' rather than '/index.html', so the no-cache rule has to be broad. Without it Firebase's default max-age=3600 leaves users on stale HTML for an hour after a deploy.
Declared after the catch-all so it wins: asset filenames carry a content hash, so they can never go stale.
